title: Chapter 132: Builder Summoning Scroll
content:
Chapter 132: Builder Summoning Scroll

Wang Shuo was shocked. Did they get the news so quickly?

Although Wang Shuo did not let a single bandit go, the bandits did not return to the village at night. It was easy for Qingmu Village to know which area had problems.

Wang Shuo felt annoyed. If the city wall was not built well, something would happen.

"You two continue to practice. I'll go out for a while."

Wang Shuo walked out of the tent and rubbed his forehead.

"Agui, do you have any good ideas?"

"..."

"It's really useless."

Chang Gui complained in his heart. Isn't it because you didn't give me soul crystals to improve my strength, so you blame me?

Wang Shuo thought about it and decided to find Zhao Bangde first to think of a way.

Through the portal, a white light flashed, and Wang Shuo appeared in the Huangfeng Valley camp.

After not coming for a long time, the wind and sand here still hurt people's faces.

"Old Zhao, are you there?" Wang Shuo did not find Zhao Bangde in the camp.

"You kid, you haven't come here for a long time! Do you want to be lazy now that you have soldiers?" Zhao Bangde leaned out of a room and scolded Wang Shuo, feeling a bit disappointed.

But when he saw Wang Shuo's level, his voice stopped and he shut up.

It's still a progress!

"Old Zhao, I'm in trouble recently!" Wang Shuo walked over with a sad face.

Zhao Bangde was a little gloating, with a sly smile on his face: "Well, tell me, let me be happy."

Wang Shuo rolled his eyes at him.

"It's just that I want to make black iron bricks recently, but I don't know how to draw defensive runes. What should I do?" Wang Shuo drooped his eyebrows and asked in confusion.

"What? You? Make black iron bricks?" Zhao Bangde showed a shocked look, "You upgraded the town?"

This black iron wall is usually built after the town is upgraded. The main reason is that the construction process is more, it takes a long time, and the cost is high.

"No, but I got a "City Wall Construction Manual", so I plan to build the city wall bricks myself according to the steps and methods described in the manual." Wang Shuo swallowed his saliva and explained.

Zhao Bangde walked around in front of Wang Shuo, looked at him carefully, smiled slightly, and said in surprise: "Yes! My Lord Wang, you have a good opportunity!"

"But as far as I know, drawing defense runes requires a rune master or a builder. It's normal that you, a bricklayer, can't do it."

"Ah!" Wang Shuo showed a surprised expression, his face was very wonderful.

"How about this, I just happen to have a junior rune master and a summoning scroll of an intermediate architect, which can be exchanged for you."

"How many military merit points does it cost?"

"Junior rune master, 5,000, intermediate architect 20,000. This scroll was originally for you to summon an architect and then build the city wall of Huangfeng Valley."

Wang Shuo frowned, thinking about something in his heart.

After a while, he clenched his fists, gritted his teeth, and said a few words: "Then I choose the intermediate architect."

Wang Shuo made this choice mainly because he wanted to build a city wall, and the architect must be more suitable.

[Intermediate architect summoning scroll +1, military merit points -20,000. ]

Looking at the scroll in his hand, Wang Shuo did not use it immediately.

At this time, he thought about the problem of tool man and soul crystal.

"Old Zhao, I have accumulated a lot of soul crystals now. Do you want to use them for the tool man I recruited?"

"It doesn't make much sense for you to give them directly now." Zhao Bangde explained.
